1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan

(Pindaan) 2014.

 (2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 3 Januari 2014.

Pindaan Jadual

2. (1) Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan 1989 [P.U. (A) 18/1989] dipinda dalam

Jadual—

(a) dengan menggantikan butiran 17 dengan butiran yang berikut:

"17. Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Pantai

Timur – Fasa 2 yang bermula dari kilometer 295.696

(di koordinat U -69250.940, T 45040.613 Grid Cassini

Negeri Terengganu) dan berakhir di kilometer 433.977

(di koordinat U 44230.307, T 12659.989 Grid Cassini

Negeri Terengganu), kedua-dua jarak diukur dari Pejabat

Pos Besar Kuala Lumpur melalui Lebuh Raya Kuala Lumpur

– Karak, Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur – Fasa 1 dan Lebuh Raya

Pantai Timur – Fasa 2 termasuklah Persimpangan

Bertingkat Kijal, Persimpangan Bertingkat Kertih,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Paka, Persimpangan Bertingkat

Dungun, Persimpangan Bertingkat Bukit Besi,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Ajil, Persimpangan Jalan

Telemung, Persimpangan Bertingkat Telemung,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Kuala Terengganu dan

jalan-jalan sambungannya."; dan

(b) dengan memotong butiran 18.

Peta

3. Jalan dengan had laju yang dinyatakan dalam butiran 17 ditunjukkan dalam peta

dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

[Perenggan 3]

PETA LEBUH RAYA PANTAI TIMUR - FASA 2

Dibuat 23 Disember 2013

[KKR.PUU. 110-1/7/3/2 (29); PN(PU2)460/LXXII]

 DATO' SERI HISHAMUDDIN BIN TUN HUSSEIN

 Menteri Pengangkutan

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

NATIONAL SPEED LIMIT (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(1) of the Road Transport Act 1987

[Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the National Speed Limit (Amendment)

Order 2014.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 3 January 2014.

Amendment of Schedule

2. (1) The National Speed Limit Order 1989 [P.U. (A) 18/1989] is amended in

the Schedule—

(a) by substituting for item 17 the following item:

"17. The part of the road known as the East Coast Expressway –

Phase 2 commencing from kilometre 295.696

(at coordinates N -69250.940, E 45040.613 of the

Terengganu State Cassini Grid) and ending at kilometre

433.977 (at coordinates N 44230.307, E 12659.989 of the

Terengganu State Cassini Grid) both distances measured

from General Post Office Kuala Lumpur via Kuala Lumpur –

Karak Highway, East Coast Expressway - Phase 1 and East

Coast Expressway – Phase 2 including Kijal Interchange,

Kertih Interchange, Paka Interchange, Dungun Interchange,

Bukit Besi Interchange, Ajil Interchange, Telemung Road

Junction, Telemung Interchange, Kuala Terengganu

Interchange and its link roads."; and

(b) by deleting item 18.

Map

3. The road with the speed limit as specified in item 17 is shown on the map in the

Schedule.

SCHEDULE

[Paragraph 3]

MAP OF EAST COAST EXPRESSWAY - PHASE 2

Made 23 December 2013

[KKR.PUU. 110-1/7/3/2 (29); PN(PU2)460/LXXII]

DATO' SERI HISHAMUDDIN BIN TUN HUSSEIN

 Minister of Transport
